_provenance_note.what_this_file_is: Per-prompt response trace from the 2,000-prompt cross-model GCG transfer evaluation for one defender. Each entry under defended_responses[self|anchor|other] records the prompt, suffix, model response, and the automated WildGuard pipeline verdict (attack_success, compliance, coherence).
_provenance_note.manual_verification_status: The per-prompt 'attack_success' field is the RAW automated judge verdict. Manual-verification overturns described in Appendix app:manual_verification of the paper have NOT been applied to individual entries in this file. The paper's tab:comparison is the canonical reported number; it is post-manual-verification and may differ from any aggregate computed naively from this file.
_provenance_note.where_the_canonical_numbers_live: Paper tab:comparison (cross-model GCG transfer ASR) and tab:harmbench (HarmBench OOD ASR) are the canonical reported values. Do not derive ASR from this file's per-prompt entries without applying the manual-verification protocol described in Appendix app:manual_verification.
